high_level_description: stc brand style, a flat purple line-art illustration of online data security, showing a laptop and phone connected to cloud storage and a padlock shield icon.

elements.desc: A purple line-art illustration of a laptop displaying a padlock inside a shield icon, with a smartphone in front of it and a hand touching the phone screen.
Purple line-art icons surrounding the devices: a coffee mug, a shelf with books and a plant, an at-sign speech bubble, a wifi symbol, folders, a cloud-download icon, and a camera icon.
